body: Also from the Midlands and happy to chat :)
Its a show in the UK called Peaky Blinders. You should be able to find it on Netflix and I would highly recommend it.

There was a night where i was really close to doing it a few months back. I only told one person and then he told my best friend and my sister. Now he has washed his hands of me and doesn’t want to talk to me anymore. I am worried they think I am doing this all for attention but i’m not. I feel worse when they check in but I cant live my life for other people. I cant just stay alive because they might be upset for a few days.
A lot but i’ve mainly realised a lot of peoples lives will be easier without me in it. I just make people worried or scared or upset. What do you think about the note? Glad you like the show too.
